articles.title: People smuggler convicted in France found by BBC living in UK and seeking asylum
articles.description: Once described as "the godfather" of French migrant camps, he has been working in a Leicestershire village.

articles.title: Watch: People smuggler tracked down and confronted by BBC
articles.description: A convicted people smuggler is living in Leicestershire and seeking asylum while working illegally, the BBC can reveal.

articles.title: At least 13 killed in large-scale Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv
articles.description: Russia launched its biggest strikes on the city in weeks with children among the "significant number" of casualties, Ukrainian officials say.

articles.title: Starmer to formally apologise to victims of forced adoptions
articles.description: The practice saw thousands of babies taken from their mothers between 1949 and 1976.
